messages:
zoe: tiny midday joy drop — meet Penthouse, my window-cat, who invented the sun-pyramid nap. photo: https://imgur.com/a/PenthousePyramid :sun_with_face:
matt: wow the architectural integrity is impressive. is that three cushions and a hardcover? :books:
sana: the smug loaf at 0:02 is a whole mood :smirk_cat: :sparkles:
lucy: question: does Penthouse accept tenancy applications? rent paid in chin scratches. :moneybag: :cat2:
zoe: open applications but must pass the 'gentle forehead boop' test. also she demands a daily playlist of ambient purring. :musical_note:
pet-checker-bot: Friendly reminder: if bringing cats to the office showcase, complete the pet health attestation and register in People Ops: https://redwood.example.com/pet-register :information_source:
matt: posted still (for slow connections): https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T77777-F12121/penthouse_sun_pyramid.jpg
sana: poll: what should we call Penthouse's architectural style? react :one: "Midday Modernism", :two: "Loafy Brutalism", :three: "Sunbeam Minimalism"
(reactions: zoe :one:, matt :two:, lucy :three:)
pet-checker-bot: Poll results: "Midday Modernism" 1, "Loafy Brutalism" 1, "Sunbeam Minimalism" 1
lucy: unanimous tie — cat judges all disciplines equally. will craft an award certificate. :trophy:
zoe: i'll bring Penthouse's tiny ribbon for the micro-showcase on Friday. note: she prefers to be carried like a small loaf, not a handbag. :ok_hand:
